en.headline: Red flags raised at eight beaches over poor water quality forecast
en.dek: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department hoisted red flags at beaches across several districts after the Environmental Protection Department forecast very poor water quality following heavy rain.
body: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department announced on Monday that red flags have been hoisted at eight beaches because the Environmental Protection Department’s Beach Water Quality Forecast Index stands at 4, indicating very poor predicted water quality.

The affected beaches are Deep Water Bay, Stanley Main Beach, Shek O Beach and Big Wave Bay Beach on Hong Kong Island; Silver Mine Bay Beach in Islands District; Clear Water Bay Second Beach in Sai Kung; Ting Kau Beach in Tsuen Wan; and Tai Po Lung Mei Beach in Tai Po. Beachgoers are advised not to enter the water to safeguard their health.

Separately, a red flag was also raised at Pui O Beach in Islands District because of big waves. The department said the water-quality forecasts reflect potential transient fluctuations caused by recent heavy rain.

zh.headline: 八個泳灘因水質預測非常差懸掛紅旗
zh.dek: 康文署表示，環保署泳灘水質預測指數為4，多個泳灘水質預測屬非常差，已懸掛紅旗，呼籲泳客不要下水。
body: 康樂及文化事務署周一宣布，因環境保護署泳灘水質預測系統指數達4，即水質預測屬非常差，多個泳灘已懸掛紅旗。
受影響泳灘包括港島深水灣、赤柱正灘、石澳及大浪灣泳灘；離島區銀礦灣泳灘；西貢清水灣二灘；荃灣汀九泳灘；以及大埔龍尾泳灘。署方呼籲泳客為健康著想，不要進入水中。
另外，離島區貝澳泳灘因大浪亦懸掛紅旗。署方指出，水質預測反映近日大雨可能引致的短暫水質波動。
